description: Edit an existing image with a natural-language instruction (e.g. 'make the background nighttime, keep the foreground unchanged'). Preserves the input's width, height and aspect ratio by default. The input file is never overwritten.

image_path.description: Image to edit (absolute, or relative to the project)

include_preview.description: Also return a small JPEG preview in the tool result. Default false: images stay local and are not sent to the model.

output_path.description: Optional destination (absolute, or relative to the project). Must be inside the project or the app output folder. Existing files are never overwritten; a numbered name is used instead.

preserve_dimensions.description: Keep the input's exact width/height (default true)

prompt.description: The edit instruction, written by you in English and used as is (Kokon does not rewrite it): start with the operation (Change, Replace, Remove, Add, Turn...), say exactly what changes, where, and what it becomes, in 20-60 words; describe only what changes and end with 'Keep everything else in the image unchanged.' For a whole-image style or mood change, end with 'Keep the composition and the subjects unchanged.' instead.

quality.description: All run Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo (8 steps): fast = ~1 MP (the default, fastest); balanced = ~1.5K; quality = native 2K (slowest; edits share 2K with their references)

seed.description: Seed for reproducible results; omit or -1 for random. Never reuse the seed the source image was generated with: use a different one or omit it

name: edit_image
title: Edit image
